_comment: Pictures in a History Writer story (tools/images.py, voice.md §14). Asked for by the author on the first pilot, 2026-10-03: 'It makes more sense to compile the images as we are gathering this info … so I can get a better sense of the content before publishing to the web.' Real photographs, documents and maps only, gathered from open archives while researching, each with its licence, its credit and a caption whose facts are checked like any claim.
_allowedLicenses: Matched as a prefix of the Commons LicenseShortName ('CC BY-SA 4.0' is CC BY-SA). A paid product may use these with credit; CC BY-SA binds the image itself, never the story. NC and ND licences, 'fair use' and anything unknown are refused.
_minCaptionEvidenceWords: A caption's facts are checked against the image's own description (saved when the image is added) or a story source, like a claim. Commons descriptions are short, so the floor is lower than a chapter claim's.

landmarkLinks.label: Seattle Landmarks
landmarkLinks._comment: The first time a chapter names a designated landmark (its name, or its address in any common spelling), the landed text links it to its page on the public Seattle Landmarks site, and the Sources list the places. The prose itself never carries the link.

maps._comment: Map snippets (tools/maps.py, voice.md §14, 2026-10-04). One small street map per landmark the book links, placed after the paragraph that first names it in the chapter that names it most, and linked to that landmark's page. Drawn from the Seattle Landmarks site's own public basemap, the same picture as the page's mini-map. The credit is required by the basemap's licence (ODbL) and travels with every map.

hoodNames._comment: The landmark guide's names for the City's neighbourhood areas (its client.json areaNames, 2026-10-07): the author's call that Mann, Minor and Atlantic read as the Central District. The book's places map labels the basemap the same way.

maps.guidePhotoCredit: City of Seattle, via Seattle Landmarks
maps._guidePhotoCredit: The landmark guide's own photographs on the book's places map: the City's, credited as the guide credits them (its client.json photoCredit), unless the guide's pack names another (imageCredit). The author, 2026-10-09: "we are leaving out photos we can definitely use here."

permission._comment: The author, 2026-10-09: "I have gotten permission to use the photos of these folks for non-commercial purposes." A picture used by permission carries `permission` {holder, scope, statedBy, date} and may appear only in a book marked non-commercial (series.json book.nonCommercial). A paid edition must clear each again: series_book.py build lists them.
